name: cs-chat-only
description: Restyles the chat: your messages and Claude's replies, and nothing of the work between them. On in every session by default; the band's chat only key or /chat-only turns it off there.

youInk.title: Chat only: your lines' colour
youInk.description: The colour chat only draws your messages in: remember is blue, planMode teal, success green, merged violet, error red, text your theme's text colour. Each follows your theme.
